MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  MONDAY, DECEMBER 4, 2023

A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
order by CHAIR YOO at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber.

2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI led those assembled in the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Yoo, Nicklas, Olson, Romanelli, Schachter

  Commissioners Absent:  Medawar, Repp-Loadsman

  City Staff Present:  Jeannie Naughton, Community Development Director
  Whitney Berry, Senior Planner
  Katrina Kawagoe, Assistant Planner
  Carol Corea, Administrative Analyst

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

A.  APPROVAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES, NOVEMBER 6, 2023.

COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER NICKLAS to,

  APPROVE THE PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES FOR THE MEETING OF
  NOVEMBER 6, 2023.

There being no objection, CHAIR YOO so ordered.

5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

NONE

6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

A.  READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS PRESENTED FOR
  CONSIDERATION TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION WILL BE WAIVED AND ALL
  SUCH ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS WILL BE READ BY TITLE ONLY.

COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER OLSON to,

  APPROVE ITEM 6A.

There being no objection, CHAIR YOO so ordered.

7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

NONE

8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-230497; LOCATION: 4020 PALOS VERDES DRIVE
  NORTH, #100, ROLLING HILLS ESTATES, CA 90274; APPLICANT: RENATA
  FERREIRA XANTHAKIS; A request for a Conditional Use Permit (CUP-230465) for a
  medical office use (physical therapy) located in an existing office park.

Assistant Planner Kawagoe provided a presentation summarizing the staff report for Planning
Application No. PA-230497. The applicant’s business plan includes individual physical therapy
sessions and scheduled small group yoga and Pilates classes focusing on pelvic floor therapy
and rehabilitation, therapy for chronic pain and age-related mobility issues. The applicant is the
only employee and anticipates 8-10 clients per day.

Assistant Planner Kawagoe stated that although the current parking for the site is legal non-
conforming, due to the low scale operation of the new business, staff has determined that the
proposed medical office will not cause any adverse effects to the parking and circulation on-site.

PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES,
DECEMBER 4, 2023
  1
 Assistant Planner Kawagoe stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission: 1) Open
the Public Hearing; 2) take public testimony; 3) Discuss the issues; 4) Close the Public Hearing;
and 5) Adopt Resolution No. PA-230497, approving the project, and in accordance with the
California Environmental Quality Act (Public Resources Code §21000 et seq.: “CEQA”),
determine that the project is Categorically Exempt under Class 1, Section 15301 – Existing
Facilities.

COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER NICKLAS to,

  OPEN THE PUBLIC HEARING.

There being no objection, CHAIR YOO so ordered.

There were no comments from the applicant or members of the public.

COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER OLSON to,

  CLOSE THE PUBLIC HEARING.

There being no objection, CHAIR YOO so ordered.

COMMISSIONER OLSON made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER NICKLAS to,

  APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-230497.

AYES: Yoo, Nicklas, Olson, Romanelli, Schachter
NOES:
ABSENT: Medawar, Repp-Loadsman
ABSTAIN:

Administrative Analyst Corea stated that the Planning Commission has approved Planning
Application No. PA-230497, inclusive of CUP No. 230465 for a medical office use at 4040 Palos
Verdes Drive North, #100. There is a 20-day appeal period by which any member of the public or
the City Council by its own motion, may appeal the decision.

  B. PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-230485; LOCATION: 701 SILVER SPUR ROAD,
  ROLLING HILLS ESTATES, CA 90274; APPLICANT: PALOS VERDES LIBRARY
  DISTRICT; A request for approval of a Variance (V-230486) to exceed allowable lot
  coverage, and a Precise Plan of Design (PPD- 230489), for the construction of a new
  terrace, adjacent to the Deep Valley Drive entrance of the Peninsula Center Library.

Senior Planner Berry provided a presentation summarizing the staff report for Planning
Application No. PA-230485. The application includes a Precise Plan of Design to allow
construction of exterior improvements, which includes resurfacing the entrance with non-skid
pavers, construction of a new 1100 SF terrace, construction of a new 634 SF at-grade patio area,
installation of new site furnishings, and reconfiguration of the planting strip in the sidewalk right-
of-way on Deep Valley Drive.

Senior Planner Berry stated that the existing library is legal non-conforming in regard to lot
coverage. Since this project will increase lot coverage a Variance is required.

Senior Planner Berry stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission: 1) Open the
Public Hearing; 2) take public testimony; 3) Discuss the issues; 4) Close the Public Hearing; and
5) Adopt Resolution No. PA-230485, approving the project, and in accordance with the California
Environmental Quality Act (Public Resources Code §21000 et seq.: “CEQA”), determine that the
project is Categorically Exempt under Class 1, Section 15301(e)(1) – Existing Facilities.

COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER NICKLAS to,

  OPEN THE PUBLIC HEARING.

There being no objection, CHAIR YOO so ordered.

Carol Beth Cozen, Architect and Palos Verdes Estates resident, provided details of the project
and presented a video rendering of the proposed design.

Alan Rigg, assistant for the Peninsula Library project and resident of Rancho Palos Verdes,
provided a detailed presentation on the proposed project. Mr. Rigg stated that in designing the
project, they recognized the proximity to the units at Merrill Gardens. To provide screening for
privacy, the project will include installing vegetation. He added that they have written support from
Merrill Gardens.

PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES,
DECEMBER 4, 2023
  2
 COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER NICKLAS to,

  CLOSE THE PUBLIC HEARING.

There being no objection, CHAIR YOO so ordered.

COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI asked if the unit shown in the presentation is occupied. Ms.
Cozen stated that it is occupied. They spoke with the property owner and their daughter, and they
are in support of the project.

COMMISSIONER NICKLAS asked if the space will be utilized for parties. Ms. Cozen stated that
the space is being designed only for the patrons. On the Silver Spur side, there are no outdoor
benches. In the future the space could be used for small lectures; nothing is scheduled and is
being designed for the community to enjoy the outdoors.

COMMISSIONER NICKLAS asked if the furniture is permanent. Jill Oliver, Project Manager,
stated that the terrace will consist of a u-shaped built-in perimeter bench, moveable furniture and
chargers for laptops and phones.

COMMISSIONER OLSON asked if the terrace is accessible to the public 24 hours a day. Ms.
Cozen stated that there haven’t been any issues and this will be a small addition to what is
existing.

COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER OLSON to,

  APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-230497.

AYES: Yoo, Nicklas, Olson, Romanelli, Schachter
NOES:
ABSENT: Medawar, Repp-Loadsman
ABSTAIN:

Administrative Analyst Corea stated that the Planning Commission has approved Planning
Application No. PA-230485, inclusive of V-230486 and PPD-230489, for the construction of a new
terrace at the Peninsula Center Library located at 701 Silver Spur Road. There is a 20-day appeal
period by which any member of the public or the City Council by its own motion, may appeal the
decision.

9.  COMMISSIONER ITEMS

COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER thanked Senior Panner Berry on a good staff report and
introduced and welcomed her to the City.

10.  DIRECTOR ITEMS

Director Naughton welcomed Senior Planner Whitney Berry.

11.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, NOVEMBER 14, 2023

COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER NICKLAS to,

  RECEIVE AND FILE ITEM 11-A

There being no objection, CHAIR YOO so ordered.

12.  ADJOURNMENT

At 7:36 p.m., CHAIR YOO adjourned the Planning Commission meeting to the adjourned Planning
Commission meeting scheduled for Monday, January 8, 2024 at 7:00 p.m.in the City Hall Council
Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates.

Respectfully submitted by,  Approved,

Carol Corea, Administrative Analyst  Victor Yoo, Chair

PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES,
DECEMBER 4, 2023
